signatures_review.finding: Every form carries wet-signature/date/seal fields (Truro: Signature + 4 Date fields + Owner-or-Authorized-Agent; Schedule A: owner signature + 9 professional signatures + prime signer + seal + 13 dates; gas: 2 signatures + Date + payment card fields; septic approval: 3 signatures + 3 dates + P.Eng Number; notification: 2 signatures + date; details: QP signature + date; alert: no signature field — contact identities only). All signatures, seals, dates, payment fields, and professional attestations are MANUAL REVIEW ONLY: never pre-fill, never sign, never affix seals, never auto-fill payment. Exact per-form binding of Schedule A repeated fields and septic opaque names (Group/CheckBox/fill_N, XFA hierarchy) is unresolved without rendered-page mapping.
